# Dev Tools — JSON Formatter, Base64 Converter & Developer Utilities

> Dev Tools provides free, private, 100% client-side utilities for developers to format, validate, and minify JSON, encode/decode Base64 and URLs, generate UUIDs, compute cryptographic hashes, and convert JSON to TypeScript interfaces.

Website: https://dev-tools.corelumetech.in/
Developer & Publisher: Corelume Tech (https://corelumetech.in)
Privacy Policy: 100% Client-Side Processing. No user data, files, or strings are collected, stored, or transmitted to any server.

## Overview
Dev Tools provides free, private, 100% client-side utilities for developers to format, validate, and minify JSON, encode/decode Base64 and URLs, generate UUIDs, compute cryptographic hashes, and convert JSON to TypeScript interfaces.

## Core Features
- JSON Formatter, Validator, and Minifier with syntax error highlighting
- Client-side Base64 string encoder and decoder
- URL component encoder and decoder (RFC 3986 compliant)
- Cryptographic Hash Generator supporting MD5 and SHA-256
- UUID v4 random identifier generator with batch generation capability
- Automated JSON-to-TypeScript interface code generation with recursive nested typing

## Benchmarks & Technical Specifications
- 100% Offline and private (sensitive developer keys and JSON payloads never leave your browser)
- Zero byte limits on client-side JSON parsing and formatting
- Sub-millisecond SHA-256 and MD5 cryptographic hashing
- Instant single-click copy for all formatted and generated outputs
